content:
Let exterior angles be \(180^\circ -\) interior angle. Sum of exterior angles is \(360^\circ\).

The 4 obtuse interior angles have exterior angles \(<90^\circ\).  
The other \(n-4\) non-obtuse interior angles have exterior angles \(\ge 90^\circ\).

Thus
\[
360^\circ > (n-4)90^\circ,
\]
so
\[
n-4 < 4 \implies n < 8.
\]
Hence \(n \le 7\). A heptagon with angles \(90^\circ,90^\circ,90^\circ,157.5^\circ,157.5^\circ,157.5^\circ,157.5^\circ\) works.

\[
\boxed{7}
\]
